messages.施術を積んで与ダメージとクイックを得る代わりに最大体力を削る、ハイリスクな嫉妬打: A high-risk Envy Blunt E.G.O that stacks Surgery to gain damage and Haste in exchange for cutting max HP.
messages.施術: 数値1につき与ダメージ量+20%、最大体力-20%で、毎ターン数値だけク: **Surgery**: Each point gives +20% damage dealt and −20% max HP, and grants Haste equal to its value every turn. He dies when it reaches 5.
messages.施術の付与: 覚醒は攻撃後に次のターンの施術1(解析Ⅲ)、侵蝕は施術2を得る。使: **Inflicting Surgery**: Awakening grants 1 Surgery next turn after the attack (Threadspin Ⅲ), and Corrosion grants 2. It stacks with every use.
messages.パッシブ「最後の改造」: 体力25%未満でこのE.G.Oを使うと、毎ターン攻撃威: **Passive — Final Augment**: Using this E.G.O below 25% HP grants Attack Power Up, Defense Power Up, and 3 Haste every turn, and he dies 3 turns later.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 敵味方識別不可の記載がない。: **Corrosion skill**: There is no mention of being unable to distinguish friend from foe.
messages.麻痺: 表面的中時に麻痺3を付与する。体力を削るリスクに見合わないので、おまけ程: **Paralyze**: Inflicts 3 Paralyze on Heads Hit. It is not worth the risk of cutting HP, so treat it as a minor extra.
messages.施術は1〜2に抑え、体力に気を付ける。最大体力が減るので、不利なマッチは守備で処: Keep Surgery at 1–2 and watch his HP. His max HP drops, so handle unfavorable Clashes with Defense skills and avoid taking hits.
messages.連戦では序盤に施術を積んでおくと、後のウェーブを高い与ダメージで始められる。: In consecutive battles, stacking Surgery early lets later waves start with high damage.
messages.「最後の改造」は使い捨ての終盤火力。発動前の体力調整が前提になる。: Final Augment is single-use late-game damage. It assumes adjusting his HP before triggering it.
messages.必要資源は怠惰2・傲慢1・嫉妬2、精神消耗は覚醒・侵蝕とも20。: It requires 2 Sloth, 1 Pride, and 2 Envy, with a Sanity cost of 20 for both Awakening and Corrosion.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が23になり、覚醒に施術の付与が加わる。侵蝕には混乱区間の前進が付: **Ⅲ**: Base Power becomes 23, and Awakening gains Surgery infliction. Corrosion gains a Stagger Threshold shift.
messages.Ⅳ: 覚醒・侵蝕の攻撃加重値が2になり、広域化する。: **Ⅳ**: Awakening and Corrosion reach 2 Attack Weight, becoming multi-target.
messages.剣契頭目: 失った体力に応じてダメージ量が伸びる肉斬・骨断を持ち、パッシブで致死: **[Blade Lineage Mentor](persona:0508)**: Has Yield My Flesh and To Claim Their Bones, whose damage grows with HP lost, and his passive survives lethal damage once.
messages.N社大鎚: 体力50%未満でコイン威力が上がる「貫く」や、体力50%未満で保護3: **[N Corp. Großhammer](persona:0504)**: Has Drive, which gains Coin Power below 50% HP, and a passive that grants 3 Protection and more below 50% HP, so he makes good use of a lowered-HP state.
